tickets.title: Prepare mortgage reset and refinance comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side review of Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk’s current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs. Reflect the upcoming rate change window and the household’s decision need to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender.
tickets.evidence: Liora asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-03.

tickets.title: Analyze loan reset timing recommendation
tickets.text: Provide a recommendation on whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender, based on the mortgage servicer’s upcoming rate change window. Deliver the recommendation early enough for the household to decide before the rate change takes effect.
tickets.evidence: For loan reset timing analysis, the mortgage servicer’s notice shows an upcoming rate change window, and the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.text: Collect the missing HELOC statement pages from Velvet Acorn Custody, including the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture for the household’s debt restructuring planning.
tickets.evidence: For HELOC document collection, the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Review cash-flow discrepancy in property tax and insurance estimates
tickets.text: Review and reconcile the discrepancy between the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget regarding monthly property tax and insurance amounts. Resolve the uncertainty in projected payments after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: For the cash-flow discrepancy review, the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Resolve bank autopay duplicate draft issue
tickets.text: Resolve the Teacup Comet Bank autopay issue that drafted the HELOC payment twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted. Implement a fix to prevent duplicate drafts and protect the household’s cash reserves.
tickets.evidence: For the bank autopay issue and reserve protection, Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.

tickets.title: Analyze debt repayment funding from investment portfolio
tickets.text: Analyze the tax and concentration implications of selling Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares from Liora’s taxable investment account to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan. Evaluate the tax lots’ holding periods and unrealized gains to determine the most efficient funding source while reducing concentration risk.
